rotation_wall_crossings.name: Centre blades: bridge and climb
rotation_wall_crossings.description: Three 8.4 metre centre-mounted blades, turning in the reversed direction. Y swings across a level gap; x and z pause on slopes reaching grid landings three metres higher. All static landings belong to the source grid.

rotation_array_compare.name: Forward through a tilted 2D array
rotation_array_compare.description: Four 4 by 10 arrays compare x, y, z and combined X-then-Y-then-Z rotation. Angles increase ten degrees per row from zero to ninety along forward z. Fixed centres, matching collision and visible cube edges expose the changing route.
